gate_type: ARCHITECTURE / DESIGN GATE — DOCUMENTATION & EVIDENCE ONLY (NO PRODUCTION MIGRATION IMPLEMENTATION)
objective: Freeze the migration architecture that moves accepted ASSY behavior into the vNext hierarchical/federated model (TIPA Workspace -> ASSY Simulation Scope -> ASSY-SL01..06 child Simulation Scopes -> station/AP/WIP/carrier Simulation Objects) WITHOUT rewriting AssyLineRuntime domain semantics, losing accepted UX/runtime behavior, or creating two runtime paths between standalone and federated hosts. Deliver: migration inventory, hosting model, runtime reuse/wrap/adapt matrix, identity/context migration contract, parent/child authority matrix, regression-invariant table with repo evidence, UI preservation mapping, observation/event/capability mapping, migration sequence/dependencies, and risks/rollback/STOP assessment. Implementation comes later.
explicit_non_objectives: No TIPA Workspace or ASSY federation implementation
No refactor of accepted domain logic
No fake simulations for other TIPA production lines
forbidden_actions: Implement TIPA Workspace or ASSY federation
Create fake simulations for other TIPA production lines
stop_conditions: Standalone and federated hosting cannot preserve the same AssyLineRuntime semantics
Mapping to TIPA -> ASSY -> ASSY-SL01..06 requires flattening or retyping the accepted hierarchy
Preserving regression invariants requires a domain-runtime rewrite
Current accepted tests/evidence materially conflict with the frozen target and require an Owner/SA decision
Migration architecture requires reopening ARCH-01..04 decisions
Implementation is required to answer an architecture question safely

acceptance_criteria.description: Target hierarchy lossless and consistent with ARCH-01
ASSY regression invariants documented with actual repo evidence
